transcript: Speaker A: Thank you everyone if you liked my performance. C for cat, D for dog jaisi angrezi toh seekh li, lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se sentence tak nahi bol paate ho. Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Isse accha, tum aaj ke aaj is app pe roz sirf 15 minute English practice karke dekho... Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai... [You learned basic English but can't speak sentences. No one will respect you. Try practicing 15 minutes daily on English Seekho app. It has expert videos, AI coaching, and no ads. Trial is 1 rupee.] Speaker B: Toh install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click install to download English Seekho.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority... [English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority...]
summary: An elderly street musician warns that basic English is not enough to earn respect. He promotes the 'English Seekho' app, highlighting its 15-minute daily lessons, AI coaching, and a 1-rupee trial, ending with a call to install.
